observations: The white vehicle, layered wheels, storefront signs, table-and-chair set, food stalls and pedestrian paving are visibly rendered.

observations: The formerly failing fifth case now has its original full-resolution PNG. Street depth, warm deck undersides, road reflections, columns and lit windows are all visible.

The switch to ultra preserves these structures. Outer facade bodies remain dark and distant bright fixtures remain clipped; successful collection does not establish a large artistic improvement over high.

The vehicle interior and nose are still stylized. A large near road rectangle remains almost featureless; these observations are separate from the clean draw result.

observations: The balanced scene retains the roadway, columns, elevated decks, warm windows and several street-light pools.

Distant fixture brightness and reflections are less developed, and distant outlines/diagonal details are visibly coarser than the high/ultra frames. The lower draw count does not by itself establish acceptable art or hardware performance.

The foreground headlamp pools remain clipped and several background facade sections remain dark. There is no visual claim of a full material-realism solution.

observations: The final ultra wet frame contains the full road/deck/column composition, warm pools, reflected light and sparse windows after the repeated quality sequence.
Deep facade shadows, repeating upper forms and clipped distant fixtures persist. This last frame is not a moving-route or all-city coverage test.

observations: The final vehicle image retains the car, wheel layers, road marks, storefronts, food stalls and separate headlamp/shop-light contributions.
Dark simplified glazing, the broad front opening, near white clipping and the plain road fitting remain visible limitations.

capturedAt, renderTimeS, frameNumber, camera and physical state remain the snapshot frozen after the actual draw. Later captureProgress does not rewrite them.
The two previous 81926 native failures retain their original bytes and build. Their absent failed-export phases cannot be retroactively reconstructed.
This successful run closes the original matrix deadline case in this software-renderer environment and supports the localized scheduling fix; it is not a hardware FPS or universal latency guarantee.
The full CPU suite ran concurrently at the beginning and finished during collection; its timing note is preserved without weakening gates.
The local candidate has an observed deployment.json HTTP404. Its complete served-source and field hashes still verify; no remote deployment or source-commit identity is fabricated.
The 81926 fixed-city images are a separate actual capture checkpoint and are not relabelled as this build.

Broad dark facade areas, clipped lamps/headlamps, repeated distant forms and weak material cues on the flat road fitting remain visible. No full-city AAA or completed native driving route follows from these fixed frames.
